About Us

A Swindon Window Team, Not A Call Centre

Common Questions

FAQ

No. Site surveys are free and there is no obligation to go ahead afterwards. We come out, measure up properly, talk through the options for the opening, and give you a price based on what is actually there rather than a guess over the phone.

The entire window, not just the glass. Frame, sealed unit, hinges, handles and locks are all covered for 10 years. Plenty of installers guarantee the glass alone and leave you paying for hardware, which is where most of the problems turn up.

Yes. We supply and install, so one team is responsible from measuring up to the final adjustment. Delivery is free, and we clear up and take the old frames away with us.

Usually, yes. If a unit has misted or blown but the frame is sound, replacement glazing is far cheaper than a full window. We check the frame and the seals at the survey and tell you straight if a swap is worth doing.

We work right across Swindon and the villages around it, including Stratton St Margaret, Haydon Wick, Blunsdon, Old Town, Wroughton, Highworth, Purton and Royal Wootton Bassett. If you are just outside that, ring and ask, we will tell you either way.

It depends on the product and the opening. A single door or a couple of replacement units is usually a day. A full house of windows, a roof lantern or a set of bi-folds takes longer because of the making up and the preparation. We confirm the timescale in writing once the survey is done, so you are not left guessing.

Both. Aluminium gives you slimmer sightlines and more glass, which is why it suits bi-folds, lanterns and larger openings. uPVC is the better value option on standard replacements. We will tell you which one genuinely fits the job rather than pushing the dearer frame.
